$:set -euo pipefail
if gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/references/.gitkeep >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ALREADY_EXISTS'; exit 0; fi
content=$(printf 'Temporary placeholder for references directory.\n' | base64 -w0)
gh api --method PUT repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/references/.gitkeep -f message='chore: establish root references directory' -f content="$content" -f branch=main --jq '{path:.content.path,commit_sha:.commit.sha,blob_sha:.content.sha}'
